name: Roulette Strategy Simulator VITA
author: Gremlin Software
description:
In Roulette:
- In the long term loss is guaranteed
- In the short term, gains are possible
This simulation confirms the reality of point (1) and explores the possibilities of point (2).
Testing roulette strategies one spin at a time is a time-consuming exercise. This program runs a series of spins in rapid concession using a given strategy, until the strategy succeeds or fails.
